steps.title: Base layer
steps.description: Place 2x Plate 1x2 Tan (3023) side-by-side to make 2x2 base.

steps.title: Build head core
steps.description: Add 2x Brick 1x2 MediumNougat (3004) on base, aligned front-to-back.

steps.title: Lock the core
steps.description: Add 2x Brick 1x2 MediumNougat (3004) on top, rotated 90°.

steps.title: Top cap
steps.description: Add 2x Plate 1x2 Tan (3023) side-by-side to form a 2x2 top.

steps.title: Eyes shelf
steps.description: Add 1x Plate 1x2 Tan (3023) on front studs; add 2x Tile Round 1x1 Black (98138).

steps.title: Brow line
steps.description: Add 1x Tile 1x2 Black (2420) on the rear two top studs.
